payload.posture: Read Romans 5:1–5 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul moves through justification, peace, access, suffering, endurance, character, hope, and love poured into hearts through the Holy Spirit given to believers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
